heroHeadline: FDA Classifies Taylor Farms Lettuce Recall as Class I, Its Most Serious Designation
heroSubtitle: FDA formally upgrades its July 17 recall of Taylor Farms de México iceberg lettuce to Class I — the agency's most serious recall category — citing the outbreak's unprecedented scale rather than any new positive product test. As of CDC's Aug 27 update, the Taylor Farms/Taco Bell multistate outbreak stands at 11,458 confirmed illnesses across 20 states with 495 hospitalizations and 2 unchanged deaths in Michigan, while the broader season-wide tally across all Cyclospora clusters reached 29,024 combined cases (17,180 lab-confirmed) across 48 states as of Aug 25. Michigan's own state count, the largest in the outbreak, reached 14,510 cases and 356 hospitalizations as of Aug 27, with weekly growth continuing to slow.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
